request.description:
### Get All Products

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/products`

**Access:** 🌐 Public — no authentication required

---

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | integer | ❌ | Page number (default: 1) |
| `limit` | integer | ❌ | Items per page (default: 20, max: 100) |
| `categoryId` | integer | ❌ | Filter by category ID |
| `cityId` | integer | ❌ | Filter by city ID |
| `condition` | string | ❌ | `NEW`, `LIKE_NEW`, `GOOD`, `FAIR`, or `POOR` |
| `minPrice` | number | ❌ | Minimum price filter |
| `maxPrice` | number | ❌ | Maximum price filter |
| `search` | string | ❌ | Search by title or description |
| `sort` | string | ❌ | `newest`, `price`, `price_desc`, or `rating` |
| `tagId` | integer | ❌ | Filter by tag ID |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Products retrieved successfully",
  "data": {
    "products": [...],
    "pagination": {
      "page": 1,
      "limit": 20,
      "total": 100,
      "totalPages": 5
    }
  }
}
```

request.description:
### Create Product

**Endpoint**

`POST /api/products`

**Description**

Creates a new product listing for the authenticated user.
The user must be logged in and provide a valid Bearer token.
Images are uploaded as multipart/form-data (max 5 files).

> 🔐 Requires authentication — include `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`

---

### Request Body (multipart/form-data)

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | ✅ Yes | 5–200 characters |
| `description` | string | ✅ Yes | Minimum 10 characters |
| `categoryId` | integer | ✅ Yes | Positive integer |
| `cityId` | integer | ✅ Yes | Positive integer |
| `condition` | string | ✅ Yes | `NEW`, `LIKE_NEW`, `GOOD`, `FAIR`, or `POOR` |
| `price` | number | ❌ Optional | Positive number |
| `exchangePreference` | string | ❌ Optional | `EXCHANGE_ONLY`, `PURCHASE_ONLY`, or `BOTH` |
| `tags` | array of integers | ❌ Optional | Array of positive tag IDs |
| `additionalInfo` | string | ❌ Optional | Max 500 characters |
| `images` | file(s) | ❌ Optional | Up to 5 image files |

---

### Example Request Body

```
title        = Vintage Leather Jacket
description  = Genuine leather jacket in great condition, barely worn
categoryId   = 1
cityId       = 1
condition    = LIKE_NEW
price        = 150
exchangePreference = BOTH
additionalInfo = Open to exchange for similar items
```

---

### Success Response — `201 Created`

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 201,
  "message": "Product created successfully",
  "data": {
    "product_id": 42,
    "title": "Vintage Leather Jacket",
    "description": "Genuine leather jacket in great condition, barely worn",
    "condition": "LIKE_NEW",
    "price": 150,
    "exchange_preference": "BOTH",
    "additional_info": "Open to exchange for similar items",
    "status": "ACTIVE",
    "is_featured": false,
    "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "category": { "category_id": 1, "category_name": "Clothing" },
    "city": { "city_id": 1, "city_name": "Gaza" },
    "images": [],
    "tags": []
  }
}
```

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Message | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `400 Bad Request` | Validation error | Missing or invalid required fields |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Unauthorized | Missing or invalid access token |
| `404 Not Found` | Category not found | Provided `categoryId` does not exist |
| `404 Not Found` | City not found | Provided `cityId` does not exist |

request.description:
### Update Product

**Endpoint:** `PUT /api/products/:id`

**Access:** 🔐 Private — requires authentication (owner only)

> Only the product owner can update their listing.
> Include `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` in the header.

---

### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | ✅ | Product ID |

---

### Request Body (JSON) — all fields optional

| Field | Type | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | 5–200 characters |
| `description` | string | Minimum 10 characters |
| `categoryId` | integer | Positive integer |
| `cityId` | integer | Positive integer |
| `condition` | string | `NEW`, `LIKE_NEW`, `GOOD`, `FAIR`, or `POOR` |
| `price` | number | Positive number |
| `exchangePreference` | string | `EXCHANGE_ONLY`, `PURCHASE_ONLY`, or `BOTH` |
| `additionalInfo` | string | Max 500 characters |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Product updated successfully",
  "data": { "product_id": 1, "title": "Updated Title", ... }
}
```

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Message | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `400 Bad Request` | Validation error | Invalid field values |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Unauthorized | Missing or invalid token |
| `403 Forbidden` | Forbidden | Not the product owner |
| `404 Not Found` | Product not found | No product with given ID |
